concept: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Game Boy Color game art direction board for Sable Outpost, industrial sci-fi first-person shooter. Create a beautiful cohesive pixel-art production concept board, landscape, on dark charcoal. Main panel shows a 160x144 game screen enlarged with crisp square pixel clusters: upper 160x112 is a simple blue-grey industrial corridor with muted green machinery and teal door, a distinctive red-armoured hostile Sentinel with sloped shoulders, respirator and recessed warm visor, and a substantial foreshortened first-person steel pump shotgun with gloved hands at bottom centre. Bottom 160x32 is a clean single instrument strip, subtle thin top divider, health cross and 99 on left, small helmet portrait in centre, hostile symbol and 1 plus LOCK on right. No boxes around every item, no brand heading, no permanent controls footer, no ammo counter. Beside the game screen show clearly separated enlarged sprite studies of the shotgun idle/recoil/pump poses and Sentinel idle/walk/attack/hurt/collapse, matching same design throughout. Palette: gunmetal steel, restrained teal instrument accents, deep red enemy armour, warm ivory highlights and brown gloves. Emphasise expert pixel clustering, strong silhouettes, purposeful contrast, no blur or anti-aliasing. This is an original art direction board, not copied from any existing game. Native silhouettes must read at shotgun32x32 and Sentinel16x32. No decorative microtext or watermark.
